C1146.title: U.S. DOJ Charges NFT Fraud and Money Laundering Scheme
C1146.summary: The U.S. Department of Justice announced charges against two defendants for allegedly running an NFT fraud and money laundering scheme. Prosecutors stated that the NFT assets appeared to be a good opportunity to get rich but ultimately only led to investor losses.
